newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends lower amid fund-related pressure.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends lower amid fund-related pressure.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended lower amid late fund-related pressure, traders said.
Wheat had been higher early after the release of the USDA's weekly export sales report, which showed net weekly exports at 353,200 tonnes, above trade expectations.
But a lack of news allowed values to erode at the midsession. Traders said the session's overall light volume made it hard to read anything into the day's price action.
KCBT wheat settled one to three cents per bushel lower, with March down three cents at $4.05-1/4.
Prices were on the defensive late as Rosenthal Collins sold one million March bushels with around 45 minutes left in the session.
But traders said losses were limited in the July as Dreyfus bought on the late break. Overall, Dreyfus' Term Commodities bought 200,000 July bushels Friday.
Man International sold 700,000 March and bull-spread 500,000 March/May at 33 cents. Benson-Quinn bought and sold 600,000 March, and also bull-spread 500,000 March/May.
